why: Graphviz compiled to WebAssembly, self-contained in one ESM file with no external .wasm fetch. Replaces @hpcc-js/wasm, which the spec named but which does not publish the .wasm binary its dist requires (verified: absent from the npm tarball for both @hpcc-js/wasm-graphviz@1.29.0 and @hpcc-js/wasm@2.22.4, and 404 on unpkg and jsdelivr).
upgrade: npm pack @viz-js/viz && cp package/dist/viz.js here, then update sha256
